versions.changelog:
Initial release of ntriq-x402-content-generate-batch.

- Batch content generation for up to 500 prompts in a single API call.
- Flat $6.00 USDC pricing via x402 protocol (EIP-3009 gasless payments).
- Supports multiple writing styles and tones.
- 100% local inference for privacy and performance.
- Simple JSON API—customizable parameters for style, tone, language, and max words.
